recipe.visualDefinition: An extreme close-up portrait of a woman's face, angled diagonally, featuring warm, soft-focus skin textures and bold, stylized typography integrated into the lower right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal tilt of the face creates a dynamic tension against the vertical text.
The deep red of the lips harmonizes with the magenta-red typography.
The soft, diffused lighting on the skin contrasts with the sharp, geometric edges of the lettering.
Negative space is minimized to create an intimate, immersive viewer experience.
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up cropping (eyes, nose, and mouth only).
Typography overlapping the subject's jawline/ear area.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 90% of the frame, positioned at a 30-degree diagonal tilt from top-left to bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's right eye (viewer's left) acts as the primary focal point due to its clarity and placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, follows the bridge of the nose down to the lips, then settles on the bold typography in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extremely limited; the subject fills the frame to the edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and tan skin tones (Background/Subject).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds against a medium-value, low-contrast skin palette.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and high-chroma reds

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
Sharp, dagger-like terminals on vertical stems
Curved elements are compressed into narrow ovals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first letter of the secondary word is oversized and wraps around the primary word
Terminals are sharpened to points rather than traditional serifs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Vertical display type paired with a small, vertically-oriented script or sans-serif following a curve.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and high contrast
Matches the sharp serif aesthetic and weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution, extreme close-up portrait of a woman with warm skin tones, tilted diagonally. Focus on the eyes and lips. Soft lighting, 90s film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-condensed, high-contrast serif typography in magenta-red to the bottom right corner. Ensure the text is vertically elongated and partially overlaps the subject's jaw.

verificationChecks: Is the face tilted at a clear diagonal?
Is the typography ultra-condensed and vertically stretched?
Does the red of the text match the intensity of the lip color?
Is the crop tight enough to exclude the top of the head and shoulders?

mustRedesign: Ensure skin texture is not overly airbrushed/plastic
postGenerationChecks: Check for sharp, pointed terminals on the display type.
Confirm the magenta color pops against the warm skin tones.
Ensure the secondary text follows a subtle curve.
Check that the image feels like a 1990s R&B aesthetic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Extreme diagonal close-up + Ultra-condensed high-contrast serif + Warm/Red monochromatic-adjacent palette.
